title: Kid Howard's band at the show
summary: Barnes recalls a show band led by Kid Howard in which he soloed, with his brother Paul on sax and Willie Foster on drums.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, Howard had that in charge, Kid Thomas. This was a big man to wait for the show.

We put up a long time in the show there. Was it a good band? Yeah, we had a good band in there. That little kid he called Joe on drums. And, uh, let me see who it was. Had Joe, they had Howard. Had Howard.
Drew Howard, Paul. Myself. What was Paul playing?
I had to call him on piano. Oh, how do you call that? Paul. I can't call his name, no. He was on piano, and Willie Foster was on drums. He was on the violin.
We had a good band in there.

Was that your brother, Paul? Mm-hmm. He was on sax. Did you play a lot of jazz? Oh, man, when that jazz would come on there, they'd turn the show up. When that would start, I'd get it.
